messages:
Marta V.: quick note: GCP ca-central1 (Montreal) marketplace listing + Nutanix on-prem hybrid capacity pilot request from EdgeOps SI. Need quota numbers, hybrid connector plan, and reseller terms.
GCP-partner-ops: we can onboard SaaS or VMOffer. For hybrid, marketplace has a bring-your-own-infra SKU pattern. Need connector IAM service account and expected TPU/GPU counts.
Colin S.: pilot asks: 2 dedicated A100 nodes in GCP + 3 Nutanix-based on-prem racks for low-latency customers. burst to 5 GCP nodes. target 200 req/s at 8k tokens.
Ravi K.: compliance: Canadian PIPEDA concerns. customers want telemetry stored in Canada. need DPA + local data residency option on listing.
EdgeOps-SI: integration note: will require a hybrid agent (we'll use our agent v2). need port list + terraform snippet for GCP and Nutanix provisioning.
Nutanix-sales-bot: Nutanix partner discount requires forecast commit and signed SOW. sending SOW template to Marta.
Marta V.: terraform snippet for infra team:
```
module "gcp-marketplace-ca-central" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood/modules/gcp/marketplace.git//region"
  region = "ca-central1"
  gpu_profile = "a100-40gb"
  dedicated_nodes = 2
}
module "nutanix-hybrid" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood/modules/hybrid/nutanix.git"
  node_count = 3
  connector_version = "v2.1.0"
}
```
GCP-partner-ops: please fill quota template and we'll route to product-experience team:
```
project_id: redwood-prod-ca
requested_resources:
  - type: compute.googleapis.com/accelerator_types
    accelerator: nvidia-tesla-a100
    quota: 4
  - type: compute.googleapis.com/instance_groups
    quota: 4
justification: Hybrid pilot for Canadian customers needing low-latency inference. Initial GCP commit: 2 nodes + on-prem Nutanix racks.
```
Colin S.: action items: (1) Marta - get SOW from Nutanix and sign LOI (48h). (2) GCP - submit quota when template filled (48h). (3) EdgeOps - share agent install runbook (24h). (4) Legal - draft DPA residency option (72h).
Marta V.: scheduling partner sync Thu 14:00 ET. tagging @here :canada: :handshake:
Nutanix-sales-bot: SOW template sent; estimate 2-3 business days for discount approval.
file_notes: Hybrid pilot coordination for GCP Montreal (ca-central1) marketplace + Nutanix on-prem racks; includes terraform snippets and quota template
